summary: Product designer and design engineer, 15 years on complex, data-dense platforms where being wrong is expensive. Takes mandates nobody has defined and turns them into plans other teams adopt: design system governance at Vividly that spread across the full product and engineering org, a phased roadmap at Bluefish AI adopted by design and engineering leads, and at Dataminr a reframing of the platform's core gap that won roadmap resources and cut configuration time 65%. Designs systems and ships them in code, from Astro front-ends to design tokens and AI tooling for design teams.

bullets: Design systems, product scoping, and front-end implementation across three client engagements, each starting from an undefined brief. In two, defining the scope was the deliverable.
Built studiocartelli.com in production Astro, owning component architecture, content pipeline, and deploy.

Took an ambiguous mandate to "optimize the design system" against an ungoverned, ownerless library and defined what optimized meant: a phased roadmap with milestones and a handoff plan, adopted by design and engineering leads.

Designed and shipped three Claude skills for the design system, spec, explore, and prototype, making it machine-readable for AI, enforcing consistency at authoring time, and cutting prototype-to-handoff time in half. Specified a fourth for component generation and handed it off.

Grew the Figma component library 4x (32 to 140) and shipped a token strategy and contribution guidelines that established ownership, prototyping in code with engineering (JS/CSS) to validate the system before handoff.

Stealth startup, business health and consultancy software: scoped two products from undefined briefs, a business health diagnostic covering platform and operations review and a company-wide review system. Both scopes approved. Architecture firm: scoped hour and cost planning and invoicing software, redirecting what the firm had planned to build.
Owned multi-product-area design for a financial analytics platform tracking thousands of products, promotions, budgets, and forecasts.

Led a design system team of 2 designers and 5 engineers, writing the contribution guidelines and governance that drove org-wide adoption and reduced platform bugs 14% without dedicated engineering resources.
Introduced pre/post-mortems and formalized documentation where none existed; adopted across the full product and engineering org, not just design.
Cut user-error support requests ~35% and saved staff 4 hours/week through customized reports, bulk actions, automations, and improved validation.

Innodata: led mixed-method discovery for a human-in-the-loop medical document tool, diagnosing a data-entry error pattern and defining an automation-first redesign. Spark Hire: built the company's first design system and shipped onboarding and reference-checking features that reduced setup abandonment.

Diagnosed extensibility as the platform's core gap where others saw feature requests: designed Custom Monitoring Settings to accept any value type. Cut configuration time 65% and support tickets 45% on a platform serving 300,000+ analysts.
Led discovery across 8 managers at 5 enterprise customers, reframing an unresolved organizational debate and securing roadmap resources.
Partnered with the Data team to ship an ML-based model flagging fraudulent partner check-ins, exposing six figures of annual payout risk.
Owned end-to-end design for data collection and alerting for a ~30-person analyst team, and mentored a junior designer who was promoted within the year.
Led end-to-end design of a learning management system used by 15+ universities, supporting students, instructors, and administrators.
Established an accessibility-focused design system and designed digital asset management workflows.
